subject: Mathematical Literacy
statement: The IEB (Independent Examinations Board) is an independent, Umalusi-accredited assessment body, not a curriculum author: its NSC examinations assess the same national CAPS FET (Grades 10-12) curriculum the DBE stream uses. The curriculum text for the IEB stream is therefore the CAPS policy statement already ingested in the CAPS tree - duplicated nowhere, referenced below. What is IEB-specific is the assessment layer (Subject Assessment Guidelines, examination structure, school-based assessment requirements), which lives in ../exam_guidelines/.

sources.title: IEB - National Senior Certificate
sources.role: States that IEB NSC examinations are based on the CAPS curriculum.
